lines.zh: 我在灰白的林子里慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly through the ashen woods.
The fallen leaves crumble at a touch.

lines.zh: 我的影子很淡，几乎没有。
lines.en: My shadow is faint, almost gone.
I make no sound when I walk.

lines.zh: 木材的枝条从我身边划过去。
lines.en: Dead branches slide past me.

lines.zh: 我在这片死林里找青的东西。
lines.en: I search the dead wood for anything green.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，落地像没有。
lines.en: My steps are light, as if they never land.
I keep my nose to the ground as I go.

lines.zh: 我从枯树的空隙穿过去。
lines.en: I thread through gaps between dead trees.
I go around a heap of old bones.

lines.zh: 我走到林子深处，又回头。
lines.en: I go deep into the wood, then look back.

lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐，但走得很稳。
lines.en: I limp, but keep a steady pace.
I follow the dry creek bed up.
My horns catch a low branch now and then.
I cross a layer of white ash.

lines.zh: 我走路的姿势像在等谁。
lines.en: I walk as if waiting for someone.

lines.zh: 我停下，侧耳听林子的空。
lines.en: I stop and listen to the forest emptiness.
I stand with my eyes on the ground.

lines.zh: 风吹过我的骨架，发出细响。
lines.en: The wind through my frame makes a thin sound.

lines.zh: 我在等一句不会来的话。
lines.en: I'm waiting for a word that won't come.
There's very little fur left on me.
I lower my head and sniff the soil.
Nothing grows in this wood.
I slowly fold my forelegs.

lines.zh: 我的角上缠着一点旧布。
lines.en: A scrap of old cloth is wound on my horn.
I watch a sliver of light far off.
I haven't called out in a long time.
I rest my head against a trunk.
My shadow on the ground doesn't move.
I hear my kin on the other side.
I don't want to go, and I don't want to stay.

lines.zh: 我叹了一口气，没有声音。
lines.en: I sigh, without a sound.
When the wind stops, I'm still here.

lines.zh: 你呼出的白气，我早就没了。
lines.en: You breathe out mist; I lost mine long ago.
What are you doing here?
This wood is thoroughly dead.
Come nearer if you like; I don't mind.
I'm looking for something green.

lines.zh: 这里没有什么值得抢的。
lines.en: There's nothing here worth taking.
I'm waiting for my kin.
You'll stay too, won't you?

lines.zh: 我认得活人走路的样子。
lines.en: I know how the living walk.
You can touch my horns.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃，蹄还踩在灰里。
lines.en: I sway, hooves still in the ash.
A joint has slipped.
This hardly matters to me.
I look down: a piece of me is missing.
Half a step back, then back again.
I grit my teeth, quietly.
I kneel slowly, then rise.
I don't feel much pain anymore.
Is that food?

lines.zh: 我记不清上一次吃了什么。
lines.en: I can't recall what I last ate.
My teeth aren't much good now.

lines.zh: 这个味道让我想起来一些事。
lines.en: This smell brings something back.

lines.zh: 我不确定还吃不吃得下。
lines.en: I'm not sure I can still eat.
Step back; I'll take my time.
This is a little like the old days.
I'll take one bite after all.
This is much better than ash.
Keep some for the others.

lines.zh: 我很久没这么近看过人。
lines.en: I haven't seen a person this close in ages.
You touched me. Cold, perhaps.
I didn't step away.
You knocked the ash off my shoulder.
I nearly lost my footing.
Two faint shadows overlap, then part.
I braced on a tree to steady myself.
That reminded me of before.
Don't worry; I don't shove people.

lines.zh: 圣辉空洞里，我静得像石。
lines.en: In the hollow, I'm still as stone.
Our breath mingles.

lines.zh: 我有一群同伴，走得很慢。
lines.en: I have kin, and we walk slowly.
They're on the far side of the wood.

lines.zh: 我们靠得很近，却不说话。
lines.en: We stay close and say nothing.
I know every one of these frames.

lines.zh: 我们曾一起在这条路上走。
lines.en: We walked this path together once.
It rests its head on my back.

lines.zh: 我们都记得同一片林子。
lines.en: We remember the same wood.
They won't go far.
I'm waiting for them to come back.
None of us left first.
I pin it under a hoof.
I can see it clearly.
I pick it up and set it back.
It has no smell left.

lines.zh: 我把落下的东西摆整齐。
lines.en: I line up what has fallen.

lines.zh: 我记不住它原来的位置。
lines.en: I can't remember where it was.
I bury it in shallow soil.
It's an old button.
I lay it beside the bones.

lines.zh: 我直起腰，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I straighten up and a bone clicks.
Footsteps are coming near.
I've raised my head.

lines.zh: 这个味道不是我的同伴。
lines.en: That smell isn't my kin.
I'll wait here for it to come.
You'd better stop right there.
I'm not what I once was.
If you're leaving, leave now.

lines.zh: 哀悼结束了，现在轮到你。
lines.en: The mourning is over — now it's your turn.

lines.zh: 我跟得很轻，灰上没脚印。
lines.en: I follow lightly, leaving no prints in ash.
I know this place better than you.
I stay beside you.

lines.zh: 失去的群系里，我数着脚步。
lines.en: In the dead biome, I count your steps.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在树林里很响。
lines.en: Your breathing is loud in these trees.
I circle the dead trees.
You've been walking a long while.
I walk inside your shadow.
Only a few steps separate us.
I butt with a horn.
I'm not as strong as I used to be.
You're pushed back a step.
My hoof grazes your leg.
You dodged; I didn't press.

lines.zh: 幽暗森林里，我们成群地走。
lines.en: In the Somber Forest, we walk in groups.
I only wanted you to stop.
Your armor is too hard.
I draw my foreleg back slowly.
This wood remembers me.
First I look for my kin.

lines.zh: 灰从脊背滑落，我站了起来。
lines.en: Ash slides off my spine as I rise.

lines.zh: 这里什么都没有长出来。
lines.en: Nothing has grown here.
I rise slowly, my knees creaking.
Wind passes between the dead trees.

lines.zh: 我听见林子另一头的脚步。
lines.en: I hear steps at the far end of the wood.
I look at the sky one last time.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的毛，很快就灭了。
lines.en: Fire catches my fur and dies quickly.
I hit the ground and my bones knock.

lines.zh: 水把我泡沉了，我挣得很慢。
lines.en: Water soaks me down and I struggle slowly.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的骨架吹散了一下。
lines.en: The blast scatters my frame a little.
An arrow passes through my side.
Light passes through me; I don't understand it.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没真的吃过。
lines.en: It's been a long time since I truly ate.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我停住了。
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I stop.

lines.zh: 这里没有土地，我找不到家。
lines.en: There's no land here to call home.
